knownAmbiguitiesOrLimitations: The notification gives the A2 anti-doping syllabus but no dedicated A2 sample questions; MCQ structure was therefore matched to Annexure B’s four-option format.
Operational testing, DCO, whereabouts and ABP statements use the current NADA India catalog entries and should be rechecked if NADA or WADA updates the live procedure pages.
The WADA Prohibited List is updated annually. Current list questions are explicitly dated 2026 and should be rechecked if the application’s coverage date changes.
A TUE is not automatic after emergency treatment; retroactive eligibility and the substantive criteria still need to be evaluated by the competent anti-doping organization.

Question 005 uses the Code’s prohibited-association concept and intentionally distinguishes a professional or sport-related relationship from casual contact; the precise procedural requirements should be read with Article 2.10’s notice and opportunity-to-explain provisions.
